import requests, os, time, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
t0=time.time(); H={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"}; OUT=os.getcwd(); os.makedirs("/tmp/st",exist_ok=True)
def dl(u,o):
    if not os.path.exists(o) or os.path.getsize(o)<2000:
        open(o,"wb").write(requests.get(u,headers=H,timeout=240).content)
    return o
def parse_cif(path):
    rows=[];lines=open(path).read().split("\n");i=0
    while i<len(lines):
        if lines[i].strip()=="loop_":
            j=i+1;hdr=[]
            while j<len(lines) and lines[j].strip().startswith("_"): hdr.append(lines[j].strip());j+=1
            if hdr and hdr[0].startswith("_atom_site."):
                idx={h.split(".")[1]:k for k,h in enumerate(hdr)}
                while j<len(lines) and not lines[j].strip().startswith(("loop_","#","_")):
                    f=lines[j].split()
                    if len(f)>=len(hdr):
                        rows.append(dict(group=f[idx["group_PDB"]],atom=f[idx["label_atom_id"]].strip('"'),
                        comp=f[idx["label_comp_id"]],chain=f[idx["auth_asym_id"]],seq=f[idx["auth_seq_id"]],
                        el=f[idx["type_symbol"]],x=float(f[idx["Cartn_x"]]),y=float(f[idx["Cartn_y"]]),
                        z=float(f[idx["Cartn_z"]]),alt=f[idx["label_alt_id"]]))
                    j+=1
                i=j;continue
            i=j;continue
        i+=1
    df=pd.DataFrame(rows); df["b"]=0.0
    return df[df.alt.isin([".","A"])].reset_index(drop=True)
def parse_pdb(path):
    rows=[]
    for l in open(path):
        if l.startswith(("ATOM","HETATM")):
            rows.append(dict(group=l[:6].strip(),atom=l[12:16].strip(),comp=l[17:20].strip(),chain=l[21],
            seq=l[22:26].strip(),el=l[76:78].strip(),x=float(l[30:38]),y=float(l[38:46]),z=float(l[46:54]),
            b=float(l[60:66]),alt=l[16]))
    df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
    return df[df.alt.isin([" ","A"])].reset_index(drop=True)
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0); V,_,Wt=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc))
    R=V@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt))])@Wt; return R,qc-pc@R
def d0_of(L): return max(1.24*(L-15)**(1/3)-1.8,0.5)
def tmsc(P,Q,pairs,d0,Ln,ret=False):
    best=-1;bRT=None; ai=np.array([p[0] for p in pairs]); bi=np.array([p[1] for p in pairs])
    for cut in [d0+1,d0+2,4.5,8.0]:
        sel=np.arange(len(pairs))
        for _ in range(20):
            if len(sel)<4: break
            R,t=kabsch(P[ai[sel]],Q[bi[sel]]); Pt=P@R+t
            d=np.linalg.norm(Pt[ai]-Q[bi],axis=1); s=(1/(1+(d/d0)**2)).sum()/Ln
            if s>best: best=s;bRT=(R,t)
            ns=np.where(d<cut)[0]
            if len(ns)==len(sel) and (ns==sel).all(): break
            sel=ns
    return (best,bRT) if ret else best
def dp_align(S,gap=-0.6):
    n,m=S.shape; M=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),dtype=np.int8)
    M[0,1:]=gap*np.arange(1,m+1); M[1:,0]=gap*np.arange(1,n+1); P[0,1:]=2; P[1:,0]=1
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        Mi1=M[i-1]; Mi=M[i]; Si=S[i-1]; Pi=P[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            a=Mi1[j-1]+Si[j-1]; b=Mi1[j]+gap; c=Mi[j-1]+gap
            if a>=b and a>=c: Mi[j]=a;Pi[j]=0
            elif b>=c: Mi[j]=b;Pi[j]=1
            else: Mi[j]=c;Pi[j]=2
    i,j=n,m;pr=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        p=P[i,j]
        if p==0: pr.append((i-1,j-1));i-=1;j-=1
        elif p==1: i-=1
        else: j-=1
    return pr[::-1]
def tmalign(P,Q,topk=4,iters=4):
    n,m=len(P),len(Q); Ln=min(n,m); d0=d0_of(Ln); seeds=[]
    for L in [Ln,Ln//2,Ln//4]:
        if L<5: continue
        for s in range(0,n-L+1,max(1,L//2)):
            for s2 in range(0,m-L+1,max(1,L//2)):
                pr=[(s+k,s2+k) for k in range(L)]; seeds.append((tmsc(P,Q,pr,d0,Ln),pr))
    seeds.sort(key=lambda z:-z[0]); best=(-1,None,None)
    for _,pr in seeds[:topk]:
        cur=pr
        for _ in range(iters):
            sc,RT=tmsc(P,Q,cur,d0,Ln,ret=True)
            if RT is None: break
            Pt=P@RT[0]+RT[1]
            S=1/(1+(np.linalg.norm(Pt[:,None,:]-Q[None,:,:],axis=2)/d0)**2)
            new=dp_align(S)
            if not new: break
            sc2,RT2=tmsc(P,Q,new,d0,Ln,ret=True)
            if sc2>best[0]: best=(sc2,RT2,new)
            if sc2<=sc+1e-6: break
            cur=new
    return best

for pid in ["8E1M","9N84","7CGP","6LO8"]: dl(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.cif",f"/tmp/st/{pid}.cif")
for acc in ["Q9NPL8","Q15070"]:
    j=requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{acc}",headers=H,timeout=120).json()
    dl(j[0]["pdbUrl"],f"/tmp/st/AF_{acc}.pdb")
c9=parse_cif("/tmp/st/9N84.cif"); c8=parse_cif("/tmp/st/8E1M.cif")
c7=parse_cif("/tmp/st/7CGP.cif"); c6=parse_cif("/tmp/st/6LO8.cif")
af_t=parse_pdb("/tmp/st/AF_Q9NPL8.pdb"); af_o=parse_pdb("/tmp/st/AF_Q15070.pdb")

# stendomycin = the 9N84 chain built entirely from non-standard (HETATM) amino acids
cand=c9[(c9.group=="HETATM")&(c9.comp!="HOH")].groupby("chain").agg(n=("atom","size"),nres=("seq","nunique"))
sten_ch=cand[(cand.nres>=8)].sort_values("n",ascending=False).index[0]
LIG=c9[(c9.chain==sten_ch)&(c9.group=="HETATM")][["x","y","z"]].to_numpy()
print("stendomycin chain:",sten_ch,"atoms:",len(LIG))

def ca(df,chain,lo=None,hi=None,minb=None):
    d=df[(df.chain==chain)&(df.group=="ATOM")&(df.atom=="CA")&(df.comp.isin(AA3))].copy()
    d["n"]=pd.to_numeric(d.seq,errors="coerce"); d=d.dropna(subset=["n"])
    if lo is not None: d=d[(d.n>=lo)&(d.n<=hi)]
    if minb is not None: d=d[d.b>=minb]
    d=d.drop_duplicates("n").sort_values("n")
    return d[["x","y","z"]].to_numpy(), d.n.to_numpy().astype(int), [AA3[c] for c in d.comp]
def best_chain(df,lo=120,hi=320):
    g=df[(df.group=="ATOM")&(df.atom=="CA")&(df.comp.isin(AA3))].groupby("chain").size()
    g=g[(g>=lo)&(g<=hi)]
    return g.sort_values(ascending=False).index[0] if len(g) else df.chain.value_counts().index[0]

TARGS={
 "Tim17 (9N84, stendomycin-bound)":   (c9,"A",None,None,None),
 "Tim17 (8E1M, apo)":                 (c8,"A",None,None,None),
 "Tim23 (8E1M)":                      (c8,"B",None,None,None),
 "Tim22 human (7CGP)":                (c7,best_chain(c7),None,None,None),
 "Tim22 yeast (6LO8)":                (c6,best_chain(c6),None,None,None),
 "TIMMDC1 (AlphaFold Q9NPL8)":        (af_t,"A",80,230,None),
 "OXA1L (AlphaFold Q15070)":          (af_o,"A",60,350,70),
}
refP,refN,refS=ca(*TARGS["Tim17 (9N84, stendomycin-bound)"][:2])
print("ref Tim17 CA:",len(refP))

rows=[]
for name,spec in TARGS.items():
    P,N,S=ca(*spec)
    if name.startswith("Tim17 (9N84"):
        tm=1.0; R,t=np.eye(3),np.zeros(3); aln=[(i,i) for i in range(len(P))]
    else:
        tm,RT,aln=tmalign(P,refP); R,t=RT
    # full heavy-atom set of this chain, transformed into the Tim17/stendomycin frame
    df,ch=spec[0],spec[1]
    sub=df[(df.chain==ch)&(df.group=="ATOM")&(df.el!="H")&(df.comp.isin(AA3))].copy()
    sub["n"]=pd.to_numeric(sub.seq,errors="coerce"); sub=sub.dropna(subset=["n"])
    if spec[2] is not None: sub=sub[(sub.n>=spec[2])&(sub.n<=spec[3])]
    if spec[4] is not None: sub=sub[sub.b>=spec[4]]
    XYZ=sub[["x","y","z"]].to_numpy()@R+t
    # cavity grid: points within 4.5 A of stendomycin, free if >3.0 A from any protein heavy atom
    lo=LIG.min(0)-4.5; hi=LIG.max(0)+4.5; step=0.8
    gx=[np.arange(lo[k],hi[k],step) for k in range(3)]
    G=np.stack(np.meshgrid(*gx,indexing="ij"),-1).reshape(-1,3)
    near=np.zeros(len(G),bool)
    for k in range(0,len(LIG),10):
        near|=(np.linalg.norm(G[:,None,:]-LIG[k:k+10][None],axis=2)<4.5).any(1)
    G=G[near]
    free=np.ones(len(G),bool)
    for k in range(0,len(XYZ),400):
        free&=~(np.linalg.norm(G[:,None,:]-XYZ[k:k+400][None],axis=2)<3.0).any(1)
    Gf=G[free]; vol=len(Gf)*step**3
    # lining residues: 3.0-5.0 A shell around the free volume
    lin=set()
    if len(Gf):
        for k in range(0,len(XYZ),400):
            D=np.linalg.norm(Gf[:,None,:]-XYZ[k:k+400][None],axis=2)
            hit=np.where((D<5.0).any(0))[0]+k
            for i in hit: lin.add((int(sub.n.iloc[i]),sub.comp.iloc[i]))
    acid=sorted([f"{AA3[c]}{n}" for n,c in lin if c in ("ASP","GLU")],key=lambda s:int(s[1:]))
    basic=sorted([f"{AA3[c]}{n}" for n,c in lin if c in ("ARG","LYS")],key=lambda s:int(s[1:]))
    clash=int((np.linalg.norm(LIG[:,None,:]-XYZ[None],axis=2)<3.0).any(1).sum())
    rows.append(dict(structure=name,n_res_scored=len(P),TM_to_Tim17=round(tm,3),
        cavity_volume_A3=round(vol,0),n_acidic_lining=len(acid),n_basic_lining=len(basic),
        acidic_lining=";".join(acid),basic_lining=";".join(basic),sten_clash_atoms=clash))
    print(f"{name:38s} n={len(P):3d} TM={tm:.3f} vol={vol:6.0f} acid={len(acid)} base={len(basic)} clash={clash} [{time.time()-t0:.0f}s]")

tab=pd.DataFrame(rows)
tab.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"TIMMDC1_cavity_comparison.csv"),index=False)
print(tab[["structure","TM_to_Tim17","cavity_volume_A3","n_acidic_lining","n_basic_lining","sten_clash_atoms"]].to_string(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,4.4))
lbl=[s.split(" (")[0]+"\n"+s.split("(")[1].rstrip(")") for s in tab.structure]
col=["#b2182b" if "Tim17" in s or "Tim22" in s else ("#2166ac" if "TIMMDC1" in s else "#777777") for s in tab.structure]
ax[0].bar(range(len(tab)),tab.TM_to_Tim17,color=col); ax[0].set_ylabel("TM-score to Tim17 (9N84 A)")
ax[0].set_title("Fold similarity to Tim17")
ax[1].bar(range(len(tab)),tab.cavity_volume_A3,color=col); ax[1].set_ylabel("free volume at stendomycin site (A$^3$)")
ax[1].set_title("Lateral groove volume")
w=0.4
ax[2].bar(np.arange(len(tab))-w/2,tab.n_acidic_lining,w,color="#b2182b",label="acidic (D/E)")
ax[2].bar(np.arange(len(tab))+w/2,tab.n_basic_lining,w,color="#2166ac",label="basic (R/K)")
ax[2].set_ylabel("charged residues lining the groove"); ax[2].set_title("Charge of the groove lining"); ax[2].legend()
for a in ax:

plt.suptitle("TIMMDC1 keeps the PRAT fold and a groove, but loses the acidic lining of the Tim17/Tim22 conducting path",fontsize=10)
